unsubscribe.title: Turn off the weekly digest
unsubscribe.description: You'll stop getting the weekly email. Everything you follow stays exactly as it is — this only stops the mail.

confirmConsent.title: Confirm your preferences
confirmConsent.description: You, or someone using your address, ticked one or more optional boxes at checkout. Nothing happens until it's confirmed here, from the inbox the message arrived in.
confirmConsent.doneDescription: Your choices are saved. You can change them from your account whenever you like, and every marketing email carries an unsubscribe link.
confirmConsent.nothingTitle: There was nothing left to confirm
confirmConsent.nothingDescription: This is already settled — either it was confirmed before, or you've since answered from your account. Nothing changed just now, and the preferences you have are the ones that stand.
confirmConsent.networkFailed: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.

withdrawConsent.metaDescription: Take back the marketing or networking consent recorded for your email address, without signing in.
withdrawConsent.title: Withdraw your consent
withdrawConsent.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a 6-digit passcode. Once you've shown the address is yours you can take back what you agreed to — without signing in, and without agreeing to anything new.
withdrawConsent.passcodeSent: If this email can be signed in to, a passcode has been sent.
withdrawConsent.chooseDescription: Choose what to take back. Nothing changes until you press the button, and this page can only take consent away — it can't turn anything on.
withdrawConsent.marketingDescription: We stop sending marketing email to this address, including the weekly digest of what you follow.
withdrawConsent.networkingDescription: Your profile stops being shown to other people attending the same events.
withdrawConsent.continues: Your account and any tickets you hold are unaffected. You can still buy tickets, and you'll still receive purchase confirmations, sign-in passcodes and notices about your purchases.
withdrawConsent.reversible: You can turn anything you withdraw back on at any time from your account.
withdrawConsent.notDeletion: This is not deletion. If you want your personal data erased, write to info@redplanettribe.org.
withdrawConsent.doneDescription: We've sent a confirmation to your email. You are not signed in, and nothing else about your account has changed.
withdrawConsent.doneNothingTitle: There was nothing to take back
withdrawConsent.doneNothingDescription: What you chose was already off for this address, so nothing changed and we haven't sent you anything.

answerLink.invalidDescription: It may have been cut off in the message, or it may no longer be good. Ask whoever sent it for a fresh one.
answerLink.expiredDescription: Answers close when the doors open, so there's nothing left to change. Speak to the organiser at the event if something needs fixing.

privacySettings.title: Privacy
privacySettings.description: What you have agreed to, and what you can change.
privacySettings.policyNone: We have no record of you accepting the Privacy Policy.
privacySettings.policyNotWithdrawable: This is not a permission you can take back here. It is the notice explaining what we do with your data and why, and you can read it at any time.
privacySettings.marketingDescription: Event announcements, and the weekly digest of what the organizers and tags you follow have published.
privacySettings.networkingDescription: Whether other people attending the same events can see your profile.
privacySettings.stateDenied: You have not agreed to this.
privacySettings.stateUnanswered: We have not asked you about this.
privacySettings.statePending: Someone entered your email address when buying and ticked this box. We are not treating it as your answer and nothing has been sent. You can settle it below.
privacySettings.withdrawnToast: {consent} is off. We have emailed you a confirmation.
privacySettings.changeFailed: That change could not be saved. Please try again.
privacySettings.changeNetworkFailed: That change could not be saved. Please check your connection and try again.
privacySettings.loadFailedTitle: Your privacy settings could not be loaded
privacySettings.loadNetworkFailed: We could not reach the server. Please check your connection and try again.
privacySettings.footnote: Turning something off stops what it authorized, and we email you a confirmation so you have proof outside this account. It is not the deletion of your account or your data: you keep your tickets, you can still buy tickets, and you will still receive purchase confirmations, sign-in codes and refund notices. You can turn anything back on here.
privacySettings.withdrawAllLead: If you would rather not decide about each of these separately, you can take back everything you have agreed to in one step. We will tell you what that means before anything changes.
privacySettings.withdrawAllTitle: Take back everything you have agreed to?
privacySettings.withdrawAllIntro: This turns off both of the things above, in one step. Before you do it, here is exactly what changes and what does not.
privacySettings.withdrawAllMarketing: Marketing email stops, including the weekly digest of what you follow.
privacySettings.withdrawAllNetworking: Your profile stops being shown to other people attending the same events — at every event, straight away.
privacySettings.withdrawAllRetained: We keep your data. We hold it for the tickets you have and to meet our legal and security obligations. Withdrawing your permission stops us using it for the two things above; it does not erase it.
privacySettings.withdrawAllUnaffected: Your account keeps working: you keep your tickets, you can still buy tickets, and you will still receive purchase confirmations, sign-in codes and refund notices. Those are part of selling you a ticket rather than something you agreed to separately, so they carry on.
privacySettings.withdrawAllReversible: You can turn anything back on here, at any time.
privacySettings.withdrawAllNotDeletion: This is not deletion. If you want us to erase your data, that is a separate request: write to {address} and ask us.
privacySettings.withdrawAllDoneToast: Everything you had agreed to is off. We have emailed you a confirmation.
privacySettings.withdrawAllNothingToast: There was nothing left to withdraw — everything was already off.
privacySettings.withdrawAllFailed: That could not be saved. Please try again.
privacySettings.withdrawAllNetworkFailed: That could not be saved. Please check your connection and try again.
